author: JawkoCahn
body:
Just keep at it! I am sitting around 213 t9. It wasn't until t9 that I started noticing things were stronger. I've played a summoner/magic hybrid basically I hunted cthulhu for the staff that he drops, felt like one of the best magic weapons I could get.

Honestly just keep at it it's the best advice I can give you, sometimes upgraded lower equipment is and will always be stronger than higher stuff.

author: Wineaux46
body:
Gear effects can make lower tier gear better than current tier.  Gear drops from raid bosses can be better than high tier gear.  I’m almost T10, and I’m still using some T8 gear because it’s better for my class than the T9 drops.

As someone pointed out earlier, Mammon will have very good drops.  Mammon’s Sword is an offhand item that can be used by every class, and is still used at T10 until you get lucky with rarer class specific T10 raid drops.

author: Inline_skates
body: Nothren gear at t8 is incredibly good, then you get Apollyon and the fallen gods at t9 that drop some great gear (fallen god staves and incarnate for mages).

author: WriterAny
body: Ljolsofar Staff carried me well into t9 and can be obtained at t8 from Ljolsofar Lord

author: Lein_Fay
body: You can get lots of keys by doing boss gauntlets (not themed) in party. Almost 80% of bosses drops a key, and you'll be able to kill 2-5 bosses on each floor. Even for t10 players, especially those who have AoE bulids, it will be profitable,so ask them for help.
